newsitem.title: USA: H&Q cuts Komag to a hold from a buy.
newsitem.headline: H&Q cuts Komag to a hold from a buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist cut its rating on Komag Inc to a HOLD from a buy and reduced estimates.

-- In a research report H&Q cited Komag's announcement Wednesday of a significant Q2 earnings shortfall and lower results for the second half of the year after its largest customer Seagate Technology Inc. reduced orders.
-- Reduced 1997 EPS to $0.90/shr on $670 million in revenues from previous estimates of $2.20/shr and $783 million in revenues respectively.
-- Reduced 1998 EPS to $1.60/shr on $790 million in revenues from previous estimates of $3.25/shr and $960 million in revenues respectively.
-- Q2 EPS estimate $0.22 on revenues $170 million.
